'''Unikrn Inc.''' (styled as "'''Unikrn'''") is an esports betting and entertainment media company based in [[Miami]], Florida.

In August 2021, international betting, gambling and interactive entertainment company [[Entain]] acquired Unikrn.<ref>{{Cite web|date=12 August 2021|title=Online gambling company Entain buys esports betting startup Unikrn as it looks to triple its business|url=https://www.cnbc.com/2021/08/12/ladbrokes-owner-entain-buys-esports-betting-startup-unikrn.html|access-date=3 September 2021|website=CNBC}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=13 August 2021|title=Gambling giant Entain puts £50m bet on esports|url=https://www.thetimes.com/article/gambling-giant-entain-puts-50m-bet-on-esports-dgtg6x6l3|access-date=3 September 2021|website=The Times}}</ref>

== Overview ==
Founded in November 2014, Unikrn primarily offers real money<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-10 |title=Main information about the activities and objectives |url=https://goldsbett.in/about-us/ |access-date=2024-12-11 |website=goldsbett.in |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.engadget.com/2015/04/28/unikrn-esports-betting/|title=There's an easy way to bet on competitive video games|website=Engadget|date=29 April 2015 |access-date=2017-07-17}}</ref> and token-based wagering on competitive video game tournaments, otherwise known as [[esports]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bits.blogs.nytimes.com/2015/04/28/gambling-comes-to-esports-with-unikrn/?_r=2|title=Gambling Comes to E-Sports with Unikrn|work=The New York Times|date=28 April 2015 |access-date=11 May 2017}}</ref> Unikrn creates betting markets on [[esports]] (organized video game competitions) matches akin to traditional betting.<ref>{{Cite press release |last=Markets |first=Research and |date=2024-10-09 |title=United States Online Gambling Industry Research 2023-2029: Cryptocurrency Gains Momentum, Rising Popularity of Esports, Operators Capitalize on Mobile-First Platforms |url=https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2024/10/09/2960696/28124/en/United-States-Online-Gambling-Industry-Research-2023-2029-Cryptocurrency-Gains-Momentum-Rising-Popularity-of-Esports-Operators-Capitalize-on-Mobile-First-Platforms.html |access-date=2024-12-11 |website=GlobeNewswire News Room |language=en}}</ref>

== History ==
The company was founded by [[Rahul Sood]] and Karl Flores in November 2014.

In 2016, Unikrn became an investor in BIG (Berlin International Gaming),<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sporttechie.com/esports-betting-company-unikrn-invests-in-german-csgo-team-big/|title=eSports Betting Company Unikrn Invests In German CS:GO Team BIG|work=SportTechie |date=12 January 2017 |access-date=11 May 2017}}</ref> a professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive team. Unikrn also has an investment in [[MAINGEAR]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pcmag.com/news/349612/maingear-unikrn-bet-on-pc-gamings-future/|title=Maingear, Unikrn Bet on PC Gaming's Future|date=16 November 2016 |publisher=PCMag|access-date=11 May 2017}}</ref> a high-end PC manufacturer.

In the second quarter of 2017, Unikrn acquired LEET,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.esportsinsider.com/2017/04/unikrn-acquire-casino-focused-esports-company-leet/|title=Unikrn to acquire casino focused esports company LEET|date=26 April 2017 |publisher=Esports Insider|access-date=11 May 2017}}</ref> an esports startup based in Las Vegas, Nevada. Unikrn also owns an Indian-based esports company, DotaProHub.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://venturebeat.com/2015/09/22/esports-betting-hub-unikrn-buys-statistics-company-dotaprohub/|title=Esports betting hub Unikrn buys statistics company DotaProHub {{!}} GamesBeat|website=venturebeat.com|date=22 September 2015 |language=en-US|access-date=2017-09-19}}</ref>

In November 2017, the company released UnikoinGold, an [[ERC-20]] [[cryptocurrency]], running on the [[Ethereum]] blockchain.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://techcrunch.com/2017/12/04/consensys-ventures-has-made-its-first-four-investments/|title=ConsenSys Ventures has made its first four investments|last=Shieber|first=Jonathan|work=TechCrunch|access-date=2017-12-20|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://mashable.com/2017/08/17/unikoingold/#47zQpE9lHqq3|title=Mark Cuban-backed Unikrn to launch cryptocurrency for esports betting|last=Schroeder|first=Stan|work=Mashable|access-date=2018-01-15|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.cnbc.com/2017/09/25/ethereum-co-founder-and-mark-cuban-put-25m-toward-unikrn-esports-betting-platforms-digital-token-sale.html|title=Mark Cuban, Ethereum co-founder among big investors in Unikrn's digital token sale|last=Soper|first=Taylor|date=2017-09-25|work=CNBC|access-date=2018-01-15}}</ref>

In September 2020, Unikrn agreed to a settlement with the [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] after raising $31 million via a digital asset called UnikoinGold in an unregistered 2019 [[token sale]] of digital.<ref>{{Cite web|date=September 15, 2020|title=In the Matter of Unikrn, Inc|url=https://www.sec.gov/divisions/enforce/claims/unikrn.htm|publisher=[[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]]}}</ref> Unikrn volunteered to settle without a determination of guilt by paying a $6.1 million penalty to be paid via a [[Fair Fund]] to its token holders. Unikrn also undertook to disable UnikoinGold <ref>{{Cite web|date=September 15, 2020|title=Unregistered ICO Issuer Agrees to Disable Tokens and Pay Penalty for Distribution to Harmed Investors|url=https://www.sec.gov/news/press-release/2020-211|access-date=September 15, 2020|website=SEC.gov|publisher=[[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]]}}</ref> Unikrn settled despite lack of consensus within the SEC that Unikoingold constituted a security, with Commissioner Hester M. Peirce saying, "I do not concur in my colleagues’ opinion that Unikrn’s token offering constituted a securities offering[...] By failing to challenge ourselves to experiment with new approaches to regulation, we, and those whose interests we are pledged to serve, risk surrendering the fruits of innovation. I respectfully dissent from the Commission’s actions today relating to Unikrn."<ref>{{cite web | title = Statement on SEC Settlement Charging Token Issuer with Violation of Registration Provisions of the Securities Act of 1933 | publisher=[[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] | url=https://www.sec.gov/news/public-statement/peirce-statement-settlement-charging-token-issuer}}</ref> She further clarified, "[Unikrn] is not alleged to have engaged in any fraud."
